help_word_version: Pasting as a native editable equation requires Microsoft Word ≥ 16.100; older versions paste an image or plain text.
help_safari_capture: On macOS press ⌘⌃⇧4 (hold Ctrl!) to capture a formula into the clipboard; on Windows use Win+Shift+S. Then come back and press ⌘V.
help_model: The first recognition downloads an ~80MB model and caches it locally; failed downloads fall back to a CN mirror automatically.

home_about_body: SnapLaTeX is a free tool built by a trainee middle-school math teacher: it turns formula screenshots into editable native Word equations, not images. Recognition runs entirely in your browser — images never leave your device. The whole site is AGPL-3.0 open source.
home_hero_desc: A free formula OCR tool: screenshot to LaTeX, paste into Word as an editable native equation. Runs locally in your browser — no uploads, no sign-up.
